intent: 3BR / 2 bath SIDE CORRIDOR canonical smoke test, no carport. 13.5x13.5 lot gives a 10.5x9.5 envelope; the solve lands 80.7 m² of floor at 0 errors and 1 warning (window_area_habitable, present at every size tested). That is the smallest IN-BAND size for 3BR/2-bath (80-120 m²) — 13x13 also solves but at 72.0 m² falls below the band floor. A single corridor serves the entire private zone: master, br2, br3, bath1 and bath2 all door onto `hall`, which opens into the great_room. Per-room areas move between runs (CP-SAT is non-deterministic even with a fixed seed), so treat the total and the arrangement as the contract. This brief pins the anchor relaxation: the topology was INFEASIBLE at every lot size as authored because left_anchored + right_anchored + front_to_rear_stacks were declared together (the over-constrained-anchors trap); no single knob and no pair is sufficient, all three are now null, and rear_anchored plus match_bedroom_widths do the shaping. Canonical size is the band floor rather than mid-band deliberately: the bedroom hierarchy is tight (master ~12.9 against br2 ~13.1) and degrades as the lot grows, so a larger canonical would show a standard bedroom clearly outsizing the master.
must_haves: one corridor serving every bedroom and both baths
corridor opening into the great room
